name: pstack-monitor
description: A live, read-only local view of pstack work: Claude Code and Codex sessions, their subagents, and pstack's external model lanes, with what each agent is doing now.

interface.shortDescription: Watch pstack's agents and model lanes live in a local browser view
interface.longDescription: Starts a read-only local server that draws each pstack session, its subagents, and its external Codex, Grok, DeepSeek, and MiniMax lanes as a live graph. Optional companion to the pstack plugin.
